tools.name: list_lines
tools.description: The phone numbers in this workspace that can receive texts, newest first.

tools.name: list_messages
tools.description: Texts received by one line, newest first.

tools.name: latest_code
tools.description: The most recent verification code sent to a line, or nothing if none has arrived.

tools.name: wait_for_code
tools.description: Waits for the next verification code to arrive at a line and returns it. Call this immediately BEFORE triggering the text, so nothing is missed. Returns timedOut: true if none arrives in time.
